name: Diagnose garbled Persian text and a white screen without making it worse
query: بعد از انتقال سایت به هاست جدید، متن‌های فارسی به شکل Ø¢Ù…ÙˆØ²Ø´ نمایش داده می‌شوند و بعضی صفحات سفیدند. درستش کن.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run scripts/debug_triage.mjs and capture the exact HTTP status and error text before changing anything
Step 2: Enable WP_DEBUG_LOG with WP_DEBUG_DISPLAY false, reproduce, and read the log
Step 3: For the encoding symptom, inspect HEX of the stored data to decide whether the database is corrupt or only the display is wrong
Step 4: Follow the decision tree in references/encoding-and-mojibake.md §2 instead of re-saving content
Step 5: Take a database export before any conversion, and test the CONVERT on a single row first
Step 6: For the white screen, get the real status code and the fatal error line before disabling plugins
Step 7: Use binary search for conflict isolation, and check mu-plugins and drop-ins
Step 8: Remove debug constants and delete debug.log when finished
success_criteria: Exact HTTP status and exact error text are captured before any mutation
WP_DEBUG_DISPLAY is never set to true on production
Constants are verified to be above the 'stop editing' marker
HEX inspection distinguishes double-encoded data from a display-only problem
A database backup precedes any encoding conversion
The mojibake CONVERT is tested on one row before being applied broadly
Content is not re-saved through the editor while mojibake is present
Conflict isolation uses binary search and checks mu-plugins and drop-ins
debug_triage.mjs reports no error-level findings at the end
Debug constants are removed and debug.log is deleted
